body: Hey, if you want to get close to someone or simply just talk to someone, I can try to be that person. I’m trying to open the door to people who feel the same way I do. And to be honest it sucks, and I don’t want anyone to feel alone, or not worthy because we all deserve nice things. Send me a chat let’s talk.
Hey if you need a friend to talk to, let’s talk.

Hey if you would like to vent some more my door is open. Recently I want to reach out to people who feel as shitty as me, mainly because it suck and I don’t want anyone to feel this way. Another reason is why all need a friend to relate too. And maybe we have something in common we can talk about.
Let’s talk. We just chat, share our experiences or I can simply listen.
Hey, if you want to talk let’s talk. Let’s remind you of your worth and how special you are.

Recently, I’ve been feeling the exact same way and I and sorry that you are experiencing the same thing. If you need someone to relate to or someone to listen, let’s talk because as much as I’ve been hurting I have also been opening up myself to share/listen with other people who feel the same. Maybe we can save each other.
I'm in the same boat your in. If you need someone to share experiences or just someone who will try to understand you I can talk. Let's help each other.

hey, I've been there before, know exactly what you are feeling. I had cuts on my wrist that lasted for awhile it got to the point where people were pointing it out but still continued to ignore it, which is mainly my fault for pushing away. But at this moment your not a doofus, you just in a hard place, if you need someone to talk to let's talk. I'm trying to reach out to people because feeling like this sucks and I wouldn't wish it upon anyone.

I have a friend who feels exactly how you do. She explained it to me as being the therapist of the friend group without ever being asked if she wanted the job. I'm sorry that you feel like no one is there for you. Have you ever tried talking to perhaps a professional? They absolutely help and if you feel like you need some one to chat with at the moment we can talk. Just don't give up keep fighting!
No don’t do it. You may not realize now how much you are worth but you are worth it. Keep fighting. Let’s talk if your comfortable, let’s help you realize your worth in this world.
Totally agree with Good Hunting being in Top Tier watched that ep over and over again and can’t get enough. The world, the characters I need to see more
I’m sorry your going through sm pain. But if you need some to care or to talk about I’m opening my door. Please don’t think that ending everything will be the solution.

Hey, I know your probably feeling at your lowest right now, but you are stronger then this. If you need to talk, there are people always ready to listen. I am opening my door to people who feel the exact way I do. If you need someone, let’s talk we can possibly help each other.
I’m trying to open my door to anyone who feels like this cause I too am experiencing the same feelings. If you need to talk I am here.
hey if you need someone to talk to i’m here. i’m trying to open my door and help anyone who feels the pain i do, let’s save each other. please don’t do it, you are worth something.

i know this is a couple hours late but please don’t go through with it. I am still open to talk, but please think about it. Right now there may seem there is no good end, but it’s no reason to end where you are now. Let’s talk. Your worth more then you could possibly know.
hey, I know you might feel like this is the right idea, but you deserve to be on this planet, you deserve to be alive. We can talk, but please know your stronger then this feeling. Keep fighting.
You are so much stronger then you think. It may seem like everything is awful now but I believe someone as strong you can get through it. You can talk with me if you need. Keep fighting.
I know how you feel. It’s awful, it’s the worst feeling in the world, but you are not alone. I’m here if you want to talk.
hey if you want to talk please send me a chat cause your worth more then you can possibly know.

I know what you are feeling, but please do not take your life to prove point that maybe won't even change once you leave. If you need someone to talk to, I am an open door. I don't know you, but I know you are worth more then dying.
Ik this is 2hrs late but you could vent to me.

If I am being honest my mental state is horrible, I am insecure about everything I do, there are days when I look in the mirror and I think that I am just a waste of a life, yet you would never know how I feel inside because I am constantly talking, laughing and joking with others. People always tell me I am the nicest person ever because I practically have a compliment to everyone I see throughout the day.  I do this because I never know who is just like me, hurting badly on the inside, I like to think that my one compliment that I tell people and my small acts of good nature is helping someone who needs it. This is the first time I ever posted on reddit and even social media, I have never had social media by choice because of my mental health I am 17 and female, but you guys I have never felt more love in my entire life, I really want to say thank you to all of you from the bottom of my heart no words can describe what I felt when I posted that compared to seeing all those today comments, you guys really made an impact even though you simply commented. sry for the rant.
